# HalxDocs

> Full-Stack Engineer (Backend-Focused). Based in Nigeria.

## Who I am

HalxDocs is a full-stack software engineer specializing in backend systems, APIs, SaaS platforms, and developer tooling. I take contract work — fintech backends, SaaS products, CLIs, and API-heavy systems.

My primary languages are Go (Gin) and TypeScript. I work across the stack when needed.

## Projects

### Myshoplet — https://myshoplet.com
All-in-one e-commerce SaaS for Nigerian SMBs. Nigeria's answer to Shopify + WhatsApp Business + Tidio. Tech stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Paystack, Twilio, Anthropic Claude API, Cloudinary, Vercel.

### reqit — https://reqit.vercel.app
Local-first, open-source HTTP API client for developers. Desktop alternative to Postman/Insomnia. Built with Go (Wails v2) and React. Everything is stored as plain JSON files — no account, no cloud, no telemetry.

### jsonstack — https://jsonstack.dev
Fast, browser-based JSON viewer and formatter built to handle large files that break other tools. Collapsible tree view, fast search, path copying.

### lazydb — https://github.com/HalxDocs/lazydb
Keyboard-driven terminal UI for databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite). Built in Go with bubbletea and lipgloss. Like lazygit but for SQL.

### contextpack — https://npmjs.com/package/@halxdocs/contextpack
Open-source CLI that bundles an entire codebase into one LLM-ready markdown or JSON file. Published to npm.

### Nigerian Fintech Backend (client)
Production backend for a Nigerian mobile banking app — phone-number-first auth, OTP brute-force lockout, atomic wallet creation via MongoDB transactions, full ledger system. NestJS + TypeScript + MongoDB.

### Norah's Beauty Hub — https://norahsbeautyhub.pxxl.click
Full-stack e-commerce platform for a Nigerian beauty brand. React + Node.js + MongoDB + Paystack.
